artifact_observations.location: Pastries in the mid-ground and background
artifact_observations.reasoning: The textures of the pastries become increasingly smooth and plastic-like as they recede into the background. Some details, like fruit pieces or chocolate shavings, lack fine micro-texture and appear slightly 'melted' or fused into the base cake structure.
The yellow garnish on top of the chocolate cake appears to float slightly or merge unnaturally with the chocolate swirls, lacking a clear physical attachment point.
The pattern of the metal mesh tray becomes inconsistent in the background, with holes warping or disappearing irregularly, suggesting a slight failure in maintaining consistent geometric perspective.

selected_experts.reason: To verify if the objects are correctly identified as specific types of baked goods (e.g., mousse cake, tart) rather than generic food blobs.
To assess the realism of the textures, specifically checking for the 'plastic' look common in AI-generated food images.
To check for fusion artifacts where separate elements (garnishes, cake layers) might be merging incorrectly.
To ensure the depth of field and the arrangement of items on the trays follow consistent 3D geometry.

focus_areas: Texture realism of food items (avoiding plastic/waxy appearance)
Structural integrity of small garnishes and toppings
Consistency of the metal mesh tray pattern
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'plasticity' of the food items. AI often struggles with the porous texture of sponge cake and the crispness of pastry shells. Check if the garnishes (fruit, chocolate curls) have realistic physics or if they look like they were sculpted from the same material as the cake. Also, verify if the depth of field blur is optical or if it looks like a generative smear.
